judgement.reason: The product runs a separate Go API server and a Nuxt frontend server behind Caddy in one container, which Deployz cannot run as one web process, and the shown lines do not prove whether one can serve the other.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: the start script 015.sh runs 2 long-running servers in the background (/bin/backend, node /app/server/index.mjs) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The start script launches the Go backend and the Nuxt server in the background and then runs Caddy in the same container, so several long-running processes share one container.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./uploads:/uploads (docker-compose.yml app), volume ./uploads:/uploads (docker-compose.yml worker)
reviews.reason: The shown files contain no setting that moves uploads to S3, so the uploaded files under /uploads appear to need durable local storage.
